subject: [ParcelPay] Urgent: request for incident logs, timeline and evidentiary handoff
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@parcelpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: ParcelPay Ops <ops@parcelpay.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in 9/10: high latency & errors - need incident logs & evidence

Hi Kimberly,

We observed a significant latency and 5xx error spike across our production calls between 08:50 and 09:25 PT this morning. This incident impacted our checkout flow for multiple regions and our legal team is asking for an evidence packet for a pending audit.

Specifically we need:
- All request/response logs for our account (ParcelPay) during 08:30–10:00 PT, including timestamps, request ids, error codes, and any internal routing/fallback events.
- Any token-level or prompt/response material that would help auditors reconstruct user-facing errors (we understand PII concerns — if you must redact, please describe redaction approach).
- A signed chain-of-custody or attestable manifest of when files were exported and by whom.

Can you confirm you’ve received this and provide an ETA for a log export and a statement about how Redwood will handle sensitive data in the export? Our compliance lead (copied) will need this in the next 48 hours.

Thanks,
Alicia Torres
Head of Ops
ParcelPay

Attachments: soc2_evidence_request.pdf (attached from ParcelPay - request list)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@parcelpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 9/10: high latency & errors - need incident logs & evidence

Alicia — thanks for flagging and for the clear ask. We have your SOC‑2 evidence request. I’m standing up a small task force (Rishi + Monica) to collect the required artifacts. Immediate plan: 

1) I will triage live signals and coordinate extraction of the 08:30–10:00 PT window.
2) Rishi will run the extraction and produce both raw and redacted artifacts; Monica will prepare a manifest for chain-of-custody.
3) We will provide: export tarball (raw), redacted artifact set (PII masked), extraction manifest with hashes and timestamps, and an executive incident summary.

Preliminary ETA: raw export available within 48 hours, redacted package + manifest within 72 hours. If ParcelPay legal needs immutable evidence sooner, please let me know and we’ll escalate to an accelerated extraction (may require an ops window).

Couple questions to scope the export: do you want prompt/response mirror of chat transcripts (yes/no), and is there any specific subset of request headers you require?

I’ll keep you updated and copy the compliance lead.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@parcelpay.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 9/10: high latency & errors - need incident logs & evidence

Kimberly / Monica — technical notes and constraints below. Copying Alicia for visibility.

What we can produce now:
- Request/response logs (ingestion timestamp, request_id, model, route, status_code, latency_ms) for 08:30–10:00 PT. Stored in internal bucket: s3://redwood-incident-exports/parcelpay/2026-09-10/.
- KV/cache invalidation events and routing fallback traces (those will explain fallbacks under heavy load).
- System traces for GPU pool assignment and queuing (will be higher level but include queue timestamps).

Privacy/PII considerations:
- Token-level contents may include user-provided text. Per our data retention policy, we retain full request/response bodies for 90 days by default.
- For export: we can produce a redacted set where user-provided strings are replaced by deterministic hashes (sha256) plus a token-length metadata field. This preserves reconstruction fidelity for debug while removing raw PII.
- If ParcelPay requires unredacted material for an auditor, Legal/Compliance will need to approve the transfer and we will require a documented data transfer agreement and proof of authority.

Chain of custody / attestations:
- We can produce an extraction manifest (CSV) with: filename, md5, extractor, extraction_timestamp, and S3 path.
- We can have the extraction operation logged via our internal audit log and provide a signed PDF manifest (HSM-backed signature) within the 72-hour window.

Operational caveat:
- If you need immutable evidence under a legal hold, we should snapshot current buckets to an immutability storage class; that may take an extra ops window to ensure retention controls.

I’ll start the extraction now; tagging the runbook entry: RB-EXP-204 (internal).

—Rishi
Director, Runtime Ops
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@parcelpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@parcelpay.com>, ParcelPay Ops <ops@parcelpay.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 9/10: high latency & errors - need incident logs & evidence

Thanks — that plan sounds good. A few clarifications from our side: 
- ParcelPay auditors will request to see the unredacted sample for a small set of transactions (we will provide identifiers) — we understand this requires legal approval on your side. Please let us know what you need from our legal team.
- Chain-of-custody signature: is the HSM-backed manifest the same as a notarized export? We need the manifest to include extraction run id + operator id + timestamp and a checksum.
- For time sync: please confirm timestamps are in UTC and include a note about NTP drift if any.

Please treat this as urgent — our compliance review timeline is 48 hours. If you require an LOE or ticket number to prioritize, flag it and we’ll escalate internally.

Appreciate it,
Alicia
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@parcelpay.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 9/10: high latency & errors - need incident logs & evidence

Looping in to prioritize. ParcelPay is an expansion account and this audit is time-sensitive. Kimberly — please escalate to the on-call infra lead if you haven’t already and provide daily exec summaries to me and to ParcelPay leadership until the evidence packet is delivered.

I expect:
- Immutable snapshot of export stored separately (state the storage class and retention period).
- Signed extraction manifest (HSM sig) and MD5/sha256 checksums for every artifact.
- A short one-page executive summary (incident window, root cause hypothesis, mitigation taken, customer impact).

Rishi — if you need additional capacity or an ops window (for immutability steps), tell me now and I’ll clear it.

-Markus
VP, Customer Success Operations
